goal: 8 Icons, 2 Rows 4 Columns, Consistently Transparent Crystal + Refraction and Internal Bubble Effect, Serving Music and Podcast Desktop Widgets or Cover Collages.

style.rendering: Transparent glass + strong Fresnel edge light + small rainbow refraction spots.
style.material: Crystal body + chrome thin ring + internal floating musical note geometry.
style.color_palette: High saturation magenta #FF2D95 + electric cyan #00C8FF + silver white highlights
style.shape_base: Super oval or rounded square, inner icon can have a slightly bulging lens

layout.background: Radial Deep Purple to Black Glossy Base, with Slight Stardust Particles
layout.label_style: Fine White 8pt All Caps Sans Serif, Under Glowing

icons.concept: The polyline of the five-line staff passes through the crystal heart.
icons.label: WAVE

icons.concept: Play a triangular relief on top of a glass cylinder.
icons.label: PLAY

icons.concept: Vinyl outer ring and inner label, crystal double-layered
icons.label: VINYL

icons.concept: Tuning fork and wave interference fringes
icons.label: TUNE

icons.concept: Eighth note floating inside a cube.
icons.label: NOTE

constraints.must_feel: Overall, it resembles mid-2000s multimedia skin promotional images, without mixing in Metro-style flat blocks.
constraints.avoid: Text outlines are too thick, and internal elements of the crystal exceed three layers of depth from the main shape.
